scope: Manifest declarations and available lockfiles at existing catalog source pins. Includes complete MDK lock package inventory. Gradle aliases resolve through the retained version catalog. Build declarations are evidence, not installed binary provenance.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter ts-mls build && pnpm run compile && pnpm run vendor
scripts.release: pnpm build && node scripts/verify-package-tarball.mjs --check-fork-unpublished && changeset publish --provenance

project('libmarmot', 'c',
  version: '0.12.0',
  license: 'MIT',
  default_options: [
    'c_std=c11',
    'warning_level=2',
  ],
)

marmot_version = meson.project_version()
marmot_version_parts = marmot_version.split('.')

# Generate version header
version_conf = configuration_data()
version_conf.set('MARMOT_VERSION_MAJOR', marmot_version_parts[0])
version_conf.set('MARMOT_VERSION_MINOR', marmot_version_parts[1])
version_conf.set('MARMOT_VERSION_PATCH', marmot_version_parts[2])
version_conf.set('MARMOT_VERSION_STRING', marmot_version)

marmot_version_h = configure_file(
  input: 'include/marmot/marmot-version.h.in',
  output: 'marmot-version.h',
  configuration: version_conf,
  install_dir: get_option('includedir') / 'marmot',
)

cc = meson.get_compiler('c')

# Dependencies
openssl_dep = dependency('openssl', required: true)
sodium_dep = dependency('libsodium', required: true)
secp256k1_dep = dependency('libsecp256k1', required: true)

# Optional: SQLite3 for persistent storage backend
sqlite3_dep = dependency('sqlite3', required: false)

# Optional: LMDB for nostrdb storage backend
lmdb_dep = dependency('lmdb', required: false)

# Sibling nostrc libraries. These are hard requirements, exactly as in
# CMakeLists.txt (which links `nostr` and `nostr_nip44_core` unconditionally):
# credentials.c, groups.c, kp_profile.c, welcome.c and messages.c include
# <nostr-event.h>/<nostr-tag.h>, and messages.c includes <nostr/nip44/nip44.h>.
# libnostr's public <nostr-tag.h> in turn includes libnostrgo's
# "string_array.h", and libnostr's tag code links libnostrgo's string_array.
# libmarmot's link closure needs no nsync, libwebsockets or GLib symbols.
nostrc_build_dir = get_option('nostrc_build_dir')
if nostrc_build_dir == ''
  # Installed siblings (pkg-config). nips/nip44 installs no .pc, so its
  # static core library is looked up next to libnostr.
  nostr_dep = dependency('nostr', required: true)
  nostrgo_dep = dependency('libnostrgo', required: true)
  nip44_lib = cc.find_library('nostr_nip44_core',
    dirs: [nostr_dep.get_variable(pkgconfig: 'libdir')],
    has_headers: ['nostr/nip44/nip44.h'],
    header_dependencies: [nostrgo_dep],
    required: false,
  )
  if not nip44_lib.found()
    error('libmarmot requires the NIP-44 core library (libnostr_nip44_core) ' +
      'and <nostr/nip44/nip44.h> next to the installed libnostr (' +
      nostr_dep.get_variable(pkgconfig: 'libdir') + '). nips/nip44 currently ' +
      'installs only its headers; either install the library there or ' +
      'configure with -Dnostrc_build_dir=<built nostrc CMake tree>.')
  endif
  nip44_dep = declare_dependency(dependencies: nip44_lib)
else
  # Siblings from an already-built nostrc CMake tree (headers from this
  # checkout), the same fallback marmot-gobject uses for libmarmot.
  nostrc_src_dir = meson.current_source_dir() / '..'
  nostr_dep = declare_dependency(
    dependencies: cc.find_library('nostr',
      dirs: [nostrc_build_dir / 'libnostr'], required: true),
    compile_args: ['-I' + nostrc_src_dir / 'libnostr' / 'include'],
  )
  nostrgo_dep = declare_dependency(
    dependencies: cc.find_library('nostrgo',
      dirs: [nostrc_build_dir / 'libgo'], required: true),
    compile_args: ['-I' + nostrc_src_dir / 'libgo' / 'include'],
  )
  nip44_dep = declare_dependency(
    dependencies: cc.find_library('nostr_nip44_core',
      dirs: [nostrc_build_dir / 'nips' / 'nip44'], required: true),
    compile_args: ['-I' + nostrc_src_dir / 'nips' / 'nip44' / 'include'],
  )
endif

# Sources
marmot_sources = files(
  'src/marmot.c',
  'src/marmot_error.c',
  'src/marmot_types.c',
  'src/marmot_storage.c',
  'src/extension.c',
  'src/storage_memory.c',
  'src/mls/mls_crypto.c',
  'src/mls/mls_tls.c',
  'src/mls/mls_tree.c',
  'src/mls/mls_key_schedule.c',
  'src/mls/mls_framing.c',
  'src/mls/mls_app_data_update.c',
  'src/mls/mls_app_components.c',
  'src/mls/mls_key_package.c',
  'src/mls/mls_group.c',
  'src/mls/mls_welcome.c',
  'src/credentials.c',
  'src/kp_profile.c',
  'src/kp_lifecycle.c',
  'src/adopted.c',
  'src/commits.c',
  'src/convergence.c',
  'src/proposals.c',
  'src/members.c',
  'src/groups.c',
  'src/welcome.c',
  'src/messages.c',
  'src/media.c',
  'src/group_image.c',
  'src/storage_nostrdb.c',
)

# Conditionally add SQLite backend
if sqlite3_dep.found()
  marmot_sources += files('src/storage_sqlite.c')
endif

# Public include directories
marmot_inc = include_directories('include')
marmot_src_inc = include_directories('src')

# Gather dependencies. Users precede providers (NIP-44, libnostr, libnostrgo,
# then crypto) for single-pass static linkers.
marmot_deps = [nip44_dep, nostr_dep, nostrgo_dep, openssl_dep, sodium_dep,
  secp256k1_dep]
marmot_c_args = []
if sqlite3_dep.found()
  marmot_deps += sqlite3_dep
  marmot_c_args += '-DMARMOT_HAVE_SQLITE=1'
endif
if lmdb_dep.found()
  marmot_deps += lmdb_dep
endif
if get_option('adopted_key_package_producer')
  marmot_c_args += '-DMARMOT_ENABLE_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER=1'
endif
# Test-only switches (nostrc-zbmb): only in builds with tests, as in
# CMakeLists.txt (MARMOT_TEST_HOOKS).
if get_option('tests')
  marmot_c_args += '-DMARMOT_TEST_HOOKS=1'
endif

# Library
libmarmot = library('marmot',
  marmot_sources,
  include_directories: [marmot_inc, marmot_src_inc],
  c_args: marmot_c_args,
  dependencies: marmot_deps,
  install: true,
  version: marmot_version,
  # MAJOR from 1.0; 0.MINOR while 0.x, where a MINOR may break the ABI (as
  # CMakeLists.txt; 0.12 changed the MarmotMessageResult layout).
  soversion: marmot_version_parts[0] == '0' ? '0.' + marmot_version_parts[1] : marmot_version_parts[0],
)

# Dependency object for consumers
marmot_dep = declare_dependency(
  include_directories: marmot_inc,
  link_with: libmarmot,
  dependencies: [openssl_dep, sodium_dep, secp256k1_dep],
)

# Install public headers
install_headers(
  'include/marmot/marmot-members.h',
  'include/marmot/marmot.h',
  'include/marmot/marmot-error.h',
  'include/marmot/marmot-types.h',
  'include/marmot/marmot-media.h',
  'include/marmot/marmot-storage.h',
  'include/marmot/marmot-group-profile.h',
  'include/marmot/marmot-group-components.h',
  subdir: 'marmot',
)

# pkg-config
pkg = import('pkgconfig')
pkg.generate(libmarmot,
  name: 'libmarmot',
  description: 'C implementation of the Marmot protocol (MLS + Nostr)',
  requires: ['libsodium', 'openssl', 'libsecp256k1'],
)

# Tests: the same executables and test names as CMakeLists.txt.
if get_option('tests')
  marmot_test_names = [
    'test_mls_tls',
    'test_mls_crypto',
    'test_extension',
    'test_storage',
    'test_types',
    'test_mls_tree',
    'test_mls_key_schedule',
    'test_mls_key_schedule_vectors',
    'test_mls_framing',
    'test_mls_key_package',
    'test_mls_group',
    'test_app_data_update',
    'test_mls_welcome',
    'test_protocol',
    'test_commits',
    'test_ratchet_persist',
    'test_kp_profile',
    'test_adopted',
    'test_kp_lifecycle',
    'test_adopted_commits',
    'test_storage_contract',
    'test_mls_tree_vectors',
    'test_rfc9420_vectors',
  ]
  # test_kp_profile checks the public producer against the library's gate.
  marmot_test_c_args = ['-DMARMOT_TEST_HOOKS=1']
  if get_option('adopted_key_package_producer')
    marmot_test_c_args += '-DMARMOT_ENABLE_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER=1'
  endif
  foreach name : marmot_test_names
    test('marmot_' + name, executable(name, 'tests' / (name + '.c'),
      include_directories: [marmot_inc, marmot_src_inc],
      link_with: libmarmot,
      dependencies: marmot_deps,
      c_args: marmot_test_c_args,
    ))
  endforeach

  # The MDK v0.11.0 media fixtures (tests/vectors/media/) are read with
  # jansson from the source tree, as in CMakeLists.txt.
  test('marmot_test_media', executable('test_media', 'tests/test_media.c',
    include_directories: [marmot_inc, marmot_src_inc],
    link_with: libmarmot,
    dependencies: marmot_deps + [dependency('jansson')],
    c_args: ['-DMARMOT_MEDIA_VECTORS_DIR="@0@"'.format(
      meson.current_source_dir() / 'tests' / 'vectors' / 'media')],
  ))

  # MDK interoperability. The suite locates tests/vectors/mdk relative to its
  # working directory; pin it so out-of-tree builds do not silently skip the
  # MDK vectors.
  test('marmot_test_interop', executable('test_marmot_interop',
      'tests/test_interop.c',
      'tests/mdk_vector_loader.c',
      'tests/mdk_vector_stubs.c',
      include_directories: [marmot_inc, marmot_src_inc,
        include_directories('tests')],
      link_with: libmarmot,
      dependencies: marmot_deps,
    ),
    workdir: meson.current_source_dir(),
  )
endif

# nostrc-prqu.9 made producing ADOPTED-profile KeyPackages a build-time
# opt-in (MARMOT_ENABLE_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER, OFF) while libmarmot's
# group engine could not honour what they advertise (app_data_update,
# app-component group state). Since 0.12.0 it can (adopted Commits,
# nostrc-qp24.5.1.3), so the producer is on by default (nostrc-lf62); OFF
# builds a library that produces MDK 0.8-profile KeyPackages only.
# Validation/selection of ADOPTED KeyPackages is always available. The
# option has a new name so that a cache from before, holding the old
# default OFF, cannot keep it off unnoticed; the C macro keeps its name.
option(MARMOT_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER
  "Allow marmot_create_key_package_for_profile(ADOPTED)" ON)
# The old name: said once, loudly when it asked for OFF (a packager wanting
# MDK 0.8 KeyPackages only must use the new name), then dropped from the
# cache so the message does not repeat.
if(DEFINED CACHE{MARMOT_ENABLE_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER})
  if(NOT MARMOT_ENABLE_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER AND MARMOT_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER)
    message(WARNING "libmarmot: MARMOT_ENABLE_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER=OFF is ignored: the "
                    "option is now MARMOT_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER (ON). Configure with "
                    "-DMARMOT_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER=OFF to build without the adopted "
                    "KeyPackage producer.")
  else()
    message(STATUS "libmarmot: MARMOT_ENABLE_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER is now "
                   "MARMOT_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER (${MARMOT_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER})")

# ─── Library target ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_library(marmot ${MARMOT_SOURCES})
if(MARMOT_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER)
  target_compile_definitions(marmot PRIVATE MARMOT_ENABLE_ADOPTED_KEY_PACKAGE_PRODUCER=1)
endif()
# Test-only switches in the internal MLS headers (mls_test_allow_unsupported_adds,
# mls_test_leaf_without_self_remove; nostrc-zbmb): compiled into the library
# only for builds with tests, never into a release build without them (W25
# slice M re-review R3). PUBLIC: the test executables read the declarations.
option(MARMOT_TEST_HOOKS "Compile libmarmot's test-only switches" ${BUILD_TESTING})
if(MARMOT_TEST_HOOKS)
  target_compile_definitions(marmot PUBLIC MARMOT_TEST_HOOKS=1)
endif()
set(marmot_VERSION "${MARMOT_VERSION}")
# SONAME: MAJOR from 1.0; while 0.x every MINOR may break the ABI (AGENTS.md:
# 0.x MINOR for breaking changes), so the SONAME carries 0.MINOR. 0.12 changed
# the MarmotMessageResult layout (app_msg.epoch, nostrc-u7cb).
if(MARMOT_VERSION_MAJOR EQUAL 0)
  set(MARMOT_SOVERSION "0.${MARMOT_VERSION_MINOR}")
else()
  set(MARMOT_SOVERSION "${MARMOT_VERSION_MAJOR}")
endif()
set_target_properties(marmot PROPERTIES
  C_STANDARD 11
  C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
  OUTPUT_NAME marmot
  SOVERSION ${MARMOT_SOVERSION}
  COMPONENT_VERSION_HEADER "${MARMOT_PUBLIC_VERSION_HEADER}"
  COMPONENT_VERSION_HEADER_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include"
  COMPONENT_VERSION_HEADER_INSTALL_DIR
    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/marmot"
)
# apply_versioning() reads <target>_SOVERSION; without it the 0.MINOR
# SONAME above is overwritten with "0" (W24 media-v2 re-review).
set(marmot_SOVERSION "${MARMOT_SOVERSION}")
apply_versioning(marmot)

target_include_directories(marmot
  PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
  PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

target_link_libraries(marmot
  PUBLIC
    OpenSSL::SSL
    OpenSSL::Crypto
    PkgConfig::SODIUM
    PkgConfig::SECP256K1
    nostr
    nostr_nip44_core
)

if(SQLITE3_FOUND)
  target_link_libraries(marmot PUBLIC PkgConfig::SQLITE3)
  target_compile_definitions(marmot PRIVATE MARMOT_HAVE_SQLITE=1)
endif()

if(LMDB_FOUND)
  target_link_libraries(marmot PUBLIC PkgConfig::LMDB)
endif()

# Link against sibling libraries if available as targets
if(TARGET nostr)
  target_link_libraries(marmot PUBLIC nostr)
endif()
if(TARGET nip44)
  target_link_libraries(marmot PUBLIC nip44)
endif()

# Warn on everything for development
target_compile_options(marmot PRIVATE
  $<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,AppleClang>:-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wno-unused-parameter>
)

# ─── pkg-config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
configure_file(
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/marmot.pc.in
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/marmot.pc
  @ONLY
)

# ─── Install ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
include(GNUInstallDirs)

install(TARGETS marmot
  EXPORT marmot-targets
  LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
  ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
)

install(FILES ${MARMOT_PUBLIC_HEADERS}
  DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/marmot
)

install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/marmot.pc
  DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/pkgconfig
)
